meta.name: The Hills/Laguna Beach
meta.description:
Follow along as Lauren Conrad and her friends take on high school, and those life-defining years after, in sunny Southern California. Tune-in for Laguna Beach and The Hills 24/7.

Shows: The Hills, The Thrill of the Hunt, Who Wants To Date A Rock Star, Were Gonna Crash A Party, Old Friends, New Crushes
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
